categories.title: Categories to scrape
categories.description: Select which product categories to scrape. Leave empty to scrape all.

includeSponsored.title: Include sponsored offers
includeSponsored.description: When enabled, includes offers marked as sponsored (annuncio sponsorizzato). These are paid placements and may not be the most competitive.

maxItems.title: Max results per category
maxItems.description: Maximum number of offers to return per category. Set to 0 for all available offers.

proxyConfig.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfig.description: Proxy settings. Default Apify proxy recommended.
